name: crowncad-modeling
description: A mechanical modeling assistant for CrownCAD, supporting modeling from engineering drawings, parametric reconstruction of 3D models, and modeling from text descriptions, with model modification, assembly, and geometry verification.
descriptionZh: 面向 CrownCAD 的机械建模助手，支持根据工程图建模、三维模型参数化重建和文本描述建模，并提供模型修改、装配与几何验证能力。
